semantics.scope: remote leaf machine operations; never Linux subsystem or DRM emulation
semantics.authority: owner preauthorizes generation and device objects; packets cannot grant authority
semantics.sequence: strictly increasing per request channel; replies echo generation object opcode and sequence; notifications have zero sequence
semantics.values: operation-specific integer scalars; unused values must be zero; reject count mismatches and narrowing overflow
semantics.open: ram-length and notification-delay; first open carries one native RAM capability out-of-band; subsequent devices use the same registered backing
semantics.mmio_map: physical-address length protection cache; returns a non-recycled lease token; no CPU addresses on wire
semantics.mmio_unmap: lease-token length; local address lookup never crosses the wire
semantics.dma: requested IOVA and registered RAM offset; publication and invalidation complete before reply
semantics.irq: allocate(mode index count cpu) returns hwirq cookie MSI-address data per route; route operations use hwirq cookie; notifications contain cpu only
semantics.status: portable status constants, not native errno numbers
semantics.death: owner observes actual sandbox death independently of the request socket and revokes hardware before invalidating CPU RAM aliases
semantics.restart: new generation fresh RAM inode and channels; old packets descriptors and lease tokens cannot authorize new objects
